steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Audiences are the groups of people who consume media products. Understanding who they are and how they use media is central to media studies. | Key Fact: Demographic profiling classifies audiences by measurable characteristics: age, gender, income, occupation, education, ethnicity, and location. | Key Fact: Psychographic profiling classifies audiences by personality, values, attitudes, interests, and lifestyles — e.g. 'aspirers', 'reformers', 'mainstreamers'. This is often more useful than demographics for targeting. | Key Fact: Blumler and Katz's Uses and Gratifications theory identifies four needs audiences fulfil through media: information/education, entertainment, social interaction, and personal identity.
